subject: Social Media
title: Dropbox's Referral Hack
description: A quick win: understand Dropbox's Referral Hack.

hook.text: Dropbox offered 250 MB free storage for every friend you invited. The waiting list hit 75,000 overnight.

buildup.text: Traditional ads cost Dropbox $300 per customer. The referral program cost under $1 per signup.

discovery.text: The trick: both sides got rewarded. You got storage, your friend got storage. Everyone wins.

twist.text: Signups increased 60% permanently. Not a spike—a sustained growth engine powered by users themselves.

climax.text: PayPal did it first—literally paying users $10 to sign up and $10 for each referral. Costly but effective.

punchline.text: The cheapest ad is a happy user.

quiz.question: How did Dropbox's referral program drive growth?
options: Giving free storage to both referrer and invitee
